==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a village. The village is in thick wilderness. The entire area is coated in a black smoke.

The village is right on the edge of the suburbs. Despite being so close to the modern world, we love a tribal existence. We are committed to staying in the black smoke's protection.

Something scares the other villagers. People start running from the smoke. The only people who stay are an elderly shaman woman and myself.
